# Objetivo

Construir una version enriquecida de la tabla de features por credencial, usando mas informacion del trabajo previo de tiempos recalculados, esperas, transbordos y reconstruccion de etapas.

La idea es evitar umbrales absolutos definidos "a ojo". Para variables de espera y duracion se calculan percentiles globales de la distribucion de viajes observados y luego se agregan shares por credencial respecto de esos umbrales empiricos.

La unidad sigue siendo **credencial observada** (`id_tarjeta`), no usuario/persona.

## 1) Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
print("label: setup")

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import polars as pl


def resolve_project_root(start: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    current = (start or Path.cwd()).resolve()
    for candidate in [current, *current.parents]:
        if (candidate / "config").exists() and (candidate / "lib").exists():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("No se pudo resolver PROJECT_ROOT desde el notebook actual.")


PROJECT_ROOT = resolve_project_root()
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from lib.od_buffers_nested_logit import add_time_dummies_v2

print("PROJECT_ROOT:", PROJECT_ROOT)
```

    raise FileNotFoundError("No existe ninguna ruta candidata:\n" + "\n".join(str(p) for p in paths))

## 3) Helpers de viajes

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")

BASE_COLUMNS = [
    "id_tarjeta",
    "pk_viaje",
    "contrato",
    "is_qr",
    "fecha",
    "zona_inicio_viaje",
    "zona_fin_viaje",
    "paradero_inicio_viaje",
    "paradero_fin_viaje",
    "n_etapas",
    "n_etapas_recon",
    "metro_any",
    "t_total_calculado_seg",
    "t_vehiculo_total_seg",
    "te0_calculado",
    "te1_calculado",
    "te2_calculado",
    "te3_calculado",
    "te4_calculado",
    "te5_calculado",
]

TRANSFER_WAIT_COLS = ["te1_calculado", "te2_calculado", "te3_calculado", "te4_calculado", "te5_calculado"]


def scan_trip_partition(partition: str, path: Path) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    lf = pl.scan_parquet(str(path))
    available = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    missing = sorted(set(BASE_COLUMNS) - available)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"{partition} no contiene columnas requeridas: {missing}")

    lf = lf.select(BASE_COLUMNS)
    lf = lf.with_columns(pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"))
    lf = add_time_dummies_v2(lf)

    return (
        lf.with_columns(
            [
                pl.max_horizontal(
                    pl.col("n_etapas_recon")
                    .cast(pl.Int64, strict=False)
                    .fill_null(pl.col("n_etapas").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False))
                    - 1,
                    pl.lit(0),
                ).alias("n_transfers"),
                pl.sum_horizontal([pl.col(c).fill_null(0.0) for c in TRANSFER_WAIT_COLS]).alias(
                    "t_wait_transfer_total_seg"
                ),
                pl.col("metro_any").fill_null(False).cast(pl.Int8).alias("has_metro"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                (pl.col("n_transfers") > 0).cast(pl.Int8).alias("has_transfer"),
                ((pl.col("metro_any").fill_null(False)) & (pl.col("n_transfers") > 0)).cast(pl.Int8).alias(
                    "has_metro_with_transfer"
                ),
                ((pl.col("metro_any").fill_null(False)) & (pl.col("n_transfers") == 0)).cast(pl.Int8).alias(
                    "has_metro_no_transfer"
                ),
                ((~pl.col("metro_any").fill_null(False)) & (pl.col("n_transfers") > 0)).cast(pl.Int8).alias(
                    "has_no_metro_with_transfer"
                ),
                (pl.col("partition") == "2025-W17").cast(pl.Int8).alias("is_2025_trip"),
            ]
        )
    )


def build_trip_lf() -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return pl.concat(
        [scan_trip_partition(partition, path) for partition, path in TRIP_PARQUET_BY_PARTITION.items()],
        how="vertical_relaxed",
    )


def count_concentration_features(lf_trips: pl.LazyFrame, key_col: str, value_col: str, prefix: str) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    counts = (
        lf_trips.group_by([key_col, value_col])
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n"))
        .with_columns((pl.col("n") / pl.col("n").sum().over(key_col)).alias("p"))
    )

    return counts.group_by(key_col).agg(
        [
            pl.col("p").max().alias(f"top_{prefix}_share"),
            (-(pl.col("p") * pl.col("p").log())).sum().alias(f"{prefix}_entropy"),
        ]
    )
```

## 5) Percentiles globales de viajes

Los percentiles se calculan a nivel de viaje. Para espera de transbordo, el umbral se calcula solo entre viajes con transbordo, para evitar que los ceros de viajes sin transbordo dominen la distribucion.

```{python}
#| label: global-trip-percentiles
print("label: global-trip-percentiles")

lf_trips = build_trip_lf()

global_percentiles = lf_trips.select(
    [
        pl.col("te0_calculado").quantile(0.75).alias("initial_wait_p75_seg"),
        pl.col("te0_calculado").quantile(0.90).alias("initial_wait_p90_seg"),
        pl.col("t_total_calculado_seg").quantile(0.75).alias("total_time_p75_seg"),
        pl.col("t_total_calculado_seg").quantile(0.90).alias("total_time_p90_seg"),
    ]
).collect()

transfer_percentiles = (
    lf_trips.filter(pl.col("has_transfer") == 1)
    .select(
        [
            pl.col("t_wait_transfer_total_seg").quantile(0.75).alias("transfer_wait_p75_seg_among_transfer"),
            pl.col("t_wait_transfer_total_seg").quantile(0.90).alias("transfer_wait_p90_seg_among_transfer"),
        ]
    )
    .collect()
)

thresholds = {**global_percentiles.to_dicts()[0], **transfer_percentiles.to_dicts()[0]}

df_thresholds = pl.DataFrame(
    [{"threshold": key, "value_seg": value, "value_min": value / 60.0} for key, value in thresholds.items()]
)

with pl.Config(tbl_rows=-1, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=-1):
    print(df_thresholds)
```

## 6) Features enriquecidas por credencial

Las nuevas variables se agrupan en:

- shares sobre percentiles globales de espera y duracion;
- percentiles internos por credencial;
- transbordos y combinaciones con Metro;
- regularidad temporal;
- concentracion espacial de origen/destino.

```{python}
#| label: build-enriched-features
print("label: build-enriched-features")

iw_p75 = thresholds["initial_wait_p75_seg"]
iw_p90 = thresholds["initial_wait_p90_seg"]
tt_p75 = thresholds["total_time_p75_seg"]
tt_p90 = thresholds["total_time_p90_seg"]
tw_p75 = thresholds["transfer_wait_p75_seg_among_transfer"]
tw_p90 = thresholds["transfer_wait_p90_seg_among_transfer"]

lf_core_enriched = (
    lf_trips.group_by("id_tarjeta")
    .agg(
        [
            (pl.col("te0_calculado") > iw_p75).mean().alias("share_initial_wait_above_global_p75"),
            (pl.col("te0_calculado") > iw_p90).mean().alias("share_initial_wait_above_global_p90"),
            (pl.col("t_total_calculado_seg") > tt_p75).mean().alias("share_total_time_above_global_p75"),
            (pl.col("t_total_calculado_seg") > tt_p90).mean().alias("share_total_time_above_global_p90"),
            pl.col("te0_calculado").quantile(0.75).alias("p75_initial_wait_seg"),
            pl.col("te0_calculado").quantile(0.90).alias("p90_initial_wait_seg"),
            pl.col("t_total_calculado_seg").quantile(0.75).alias("p75_total_time_seg"),
            pl.col("t_total_calculado_seg").quantile(0.90).alias("p90_total_time_seg"),
            (pl.col("n_transfers") >= 2).mean().alias("share_2plus_transfers"),
            pl.col("n_transfers").quantile(0.90).alias("p90_n_transfers"),
            ((pl.col("has_transfer") == 1) & (pl.col("t_wait_transfer_total_seg") > tw_p75))
            .sum()
            .alias("n_transfer_wait_above_global_p75_among_transfer"),
            ((pl.col("has_transfer") == 1) & (pl.col("t_wait_transfer_total_seg") > tw_p90))
            .sum()
            .alias("n_transfer_wait_above_global_p90_among_transfer"),
            pl.col("has_transfer").sum().alias("n_transfer_trips"),
            pl.col("t_wait_transfer_total_seg").filter(pl.col("has_transfer") == 1).quantile(0.75).alias(
                "p75_transfer_wait_seg_among_transfer"
            ),
            pl.col("t_wait_transfer_total_seg").filter(pl.col("has_transfer") == 1).quantile(0.90).alias(
                "p90_transfer_wait_seg_among_transfer"
            ),
            pl.col("has_metro_with_transfer").mean().alias("share_metro_with_transfer"),
            pl.col("has_metro_no_transfer").mean().alias("share_metro_no_transfer"),
            pl.col("has_no_metro_with_transfer").mean().alias("share_no_metro_with_transfer"),
            pl.col("is_2025_trip").mean().alias("share_2025_trips"),
        ]
    )
    .with_columns(
        [
            pl.when(pl.col("n_transfer_trips") > 0)
            .then(pl.col("n_transfer_wait_above_global_p75_among_transfer") / pl.col("n_transfer_trips"))
            .otherwise(None)
            .alias("share_transfer_wait_above_global_p75_among_transfer"),
            pl.when(pl.col("n_transfer_trips") > 0)
            .then(pl.col("n_transfer_wait_above_global_p90_among_transfer") / pl.col("n_transfer_trips"))
            .otherwise(None)
            .alias("share_transfer_wait_above_global_p90_among_transfer"),
        ]
    )
    .drop(
        [
            "n_transfer_wait_above_global_p75_among_transfer",
            "n_transfer_wait_above_global_p90_among_transfer",
        ]
    )
)

lf_origin_stop_concentration = count_concentration_features(
    lf_trips, "id_tarjeta", "paradero_inicio_viaje", "origin_stop"
)
lf_destination_stop_concentration = count_concentration_features(
    lf_trips, "id_tarjeta", "paradero_fin_viaje", "destination_stop"
)
lf_origin_zone_concentration = count_concentration_features(lf_trips, "id_tarjeta", "zona_inicio_viaje", "origin_zone")
lf_destination_zone_concentration = count_concentration_features(
    lf_trips, "id_tarjeta", "zona_fin_viaje", "destination_zone"
)

lf_enriched = (
    lf_core_enriched.join(lf_origin_stop_concentration, on="id_tarjeta", how="left")
    .join(lf_destination_stop_concentration, on="id_tarjeta", how="left")
    .join(lf_origin_zone_concentration, on="id_tarjeta", how="left")
    .join(lf_destination_zone_concentration, on="id_tarjeta", how="left")
)

df_new_features = lf_enriched.collect()

print("shape new features:", df_new_features.shape)
with pl.Config(tbl_rows=5, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=-1):
    print(df_new_features.head(5))
```

## 7) Union con tabla base y features temporales derivadas

```{python}
#| label: join-with-base
print("label: join-with-base")

df_enriched = df_base.join(df_new_features, on="id_tarjeta", how="left").with_columns(
    [
        pl.max_horizontal(
            "share_lab_pm",
            "share_lab_pt",
            "share_lab_valle",
            "share_no_lab",
        ).alias("dominant_time_share"),
        (
            -(
                pl.when(pl.col("share_lab_pm") > 0).then(pl.col("share_lab_pm") * pl.col("share_lab_pm").log()).otherwise(0)
                + pl.when(pl.col("share_lab_pt") > 0).then(pl.col("share_lab_pt") * pl.col("share_lab_pt").log()).otherwise(0)
                + pl.when(pl.col("share_lab_valle") > 0)
                .then(pl.col("share_lab_valle") * pl.col("share_lab_valle").log())
                .otherwise(0)
                + pl.when(pl.col("share_no_lab") > 0).then(pl.col("share_no_lab") * pl.col("share_no_lab").log()).otherwise(0)
            )
        ).alias("temporal_entropy"),
        (pl.col("n_partitions") == 2).cast(pl.Int8).alias("is_observed_both_years"),
    ]
)

if RUN_BUILD:
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df_enriched.write_parquet(OUT_ENRICHED_FEATURES_PATH)
    print(f"Feature table enriquecida escrita en: {OUT_ENRICHED_FEATURES_PATH}")

print("shape enriched:", df_enriched.shape)
with pl.Config(tbl_rows=5, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=-1):
    print(df_enriched.head(5))
```

## 8) Sanidad de nuevas variables

```{python}
#| label: enriched-feature-quality
print("label: enriched-feature-quality")

NEW_FEATURES = [c for c in df_enriched.columns if c not in df_base.columns]

df_main = df_enriched.filter(pl.col("n_trips") >= MAIN_MIN_TRIPS)

quality_rows = []
for col in NEW_FEATURES:
    s = df_main[col]
    quality_rows.append(
        {
            "feature": col,
            "dtype": str(s.dtype),
            "n_null": int(s.null_count()),
            "share_null": s.null_count() / df_main.height,
            "mean": float(s.mean()) if s.dtype.is_numeric() and s.null_count() < df_main.height else None,
            "median": float(s.median()) if s.dtype.is_numeric() and s.null_count() < df_main.height else None,
            "p01": float(s.quantile(0.01)) if s.dtype.is_numeric() and s.null_count() < df_main.height else None,
            "p99": float(s.quantile(0.99)) if s.dtype.is_numeric() and s.null_count() < df_main.height else None,
        }
    )

df_quality = pl.DataFrame(quality_rows)

print("n_new_features:", len(NEW_FEATURES))
with pl.Config(tbl_rows=-1, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=-1):
    print(df_quality)
```

## 9) Correlaciones altas entre nuevas variables

Esta celda ayuda a decidir que variables pasar al siguiente clustering enriquecido.

```{python}
#| label: enriched-feature-correlations
print("label: enriched-feature-correlations")

numeric_new_features = [
    col
    for col in NEW_FEATURES
    if df_main[col].dtype.is_numeric() and df_main[col].null_count() < df_main.height
]

df_corr_pd = df_main.select(numeric_new_features).to_pandas()
corr = df_corr_pd.corr(numeric_only=True)

corr_pairs = (
    corr.where(np.triu(np.ones(corr.shape), k=1).astype(bool))
    .stack()
    .reset_index()
)
corr_pairs.columns = ["feature_a", "feature_b", "corr"]
corr_pairs["abs_corr"] = corr_pairs["corr"].abs()
corr_pairs = corr_pairs.sort_values("abs_corr", ascending=False)

print(corr_pairs.head(40).to_string(index=False))
```

## 11) Lectura esperada

La decision del siguiente clustering no deberia ser simplemente agregar todas estas variables. Primero se debe revisar:

- redundancia entre shares sobre p75/p90 y percentiles internos;
- redundancia entre concentracion espacial y numero de paraderos ya usado;
- nulls en variables de espera de transbordo para credenciales sin transbordos;
- si las variables enriquecidas cambian sustantivamente la interpretacion de los cuatro perfiles preliminares.
